🚨 Medical Alert: #HMPV Virus 🚨
#HealthForAll 
Two days ago, I highlighted the potential risks of a new viral threat, and now reports of its impact are beginning to surface. The first confirmed cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) have been detected in India.
Bangaluru: A https://t.co/kYW5MORImV https://t.co/6HHkXmB8NU

nodes.author: missjaatni_01
nodes.text: @Santosh_Rst It's important to stay informed and cautious. HMPV is a respiratory virus, but with vigilance and care, we can manage its spread. Stay safe, everyone.

nodes.author: Santosh_Rst
nodes.text:
#HMPV
Director General Health Services, 
@MoHFW_INDIA
Atul Goel says it is like any other respiratory virus that causes flu-like symptoms, mostly in elders and kids. He also says that the country is fully prepared to deal with any situation of this kind.
#hmpvvirus https://t.co/BkVi1hY136 https://t.co/6HHkXmBGDs

nodes.author: Santosh_Rst
nodes.text: Please make everyone aware about this epidemic.
